open_leads.title: Watch CISA KEV and watchTowr for in-the-wild use of the full GeoServer chain
open_leads.note: Only CVE-2026-120705 and CVE-2026-129243 are reported exploited. If later steps are seen, raise the priority of both analyses to immediate.

notes: On file, the event says watchTowr reports exploitation of these two CVEs, but sources show the exploited flaws are CVE-2026-120705 and CVE-2026-129243. The assigned CVEs are later steps of the same chain. Neither is in KEV, so both are set to priority urgent and confidence medium. Workarounds are left empty because GeoServer and government sources give none. A researcher's suggestions are not used as workarounds. curl to the NVD API was denied by permissions. Build passes and analyst check is valid. No embedded instructions were found in any page.
